**Overview
** The Logistics Planning & Analytics Manager – Warehouse Operations & AI is a data-driven leader responsible for transforming warehouse and logistics data into actionable operational and strategic decisions.
This role leads logistics forecasting, warehouse capacity modeling, KPI management, performance analytics, and executive reporting, with a strong emphasis on the practical application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), predictive analytics, and automation within warehouse operations.
The ideal candidate combines deep logistics and warehouse operations knowledge with advanced analytical capabilities and hands-on understanding of how AI and emerging technologies can improve warehouse productivity, space utilization, inventory accuracy, cost control, service performance, and management decision-making.
**Responsibilities
** Logistics & Warehouse Forecasting and Modeling
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve warehouse and logistics forecasting models covering inventory flow, inbound/outbound volume, storage requirements, warehouse capacity, labor demand, and seasonal fluctuations.
* Apply predictive analytics and AI-assisted modeling to identify future capacity constraints, operational risks, cost drivers, and service issues.
* Develop scenario models to evaluate changes in volume, inventory, warehouse footprint, transportation activity, and operating assumptions.
* Convert forecasts into actionable recommendations for warehouse operations, 3PL management, budgeting, and capacity planning.
* Identify opportunities to improve forecast accuracy through better data, modeling techniques, and AI-enabled analytics.
AI & Advanced Analytics for Warehouse Operations
* Serve as a key resource for the practical application of AI within warehouse and logistics operations.
* Identify and evaluate AI use cases that can improve:
+ Warehouse capacity and space planning
+ Inventory positioning and accuracy
+ Inbound and outbound flow
+ Labor and workload planning
+ Damage and exception analysis
+ Cost forecasting
+ Operational risk identification
+ 3PL performance management
* Use AI and advanced analytics to identify patterns, anomalies, root causes, and operational risks that may not be easily identified through traditional reporting.
* Develop AI-assisted decision-support tools and analytical workflows that help operations teams move from reactive problem solving to proactive management.
* Explore opportunities to automate repetitive analytical, reporting, data-validation, and operational monitoring activities.
* Promote responsible use of AI with appropriate attention to data quality, validation, security, governance, and human review.
* Translate emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions with measurable operational or financial value.
KPI Management & Operational Analytics
Own and continuously improve key warehouse and logistics performance metrics, including:
* Logistics Expense Rate
* Inventory Accuracy
* Damage Rate
* Warehouse Utilization Rate
* Capacity and storage utilization
* Inbound/outbound throughput
* Cost and service performance
**Additional Responsibilities Include
**
* Collect, validate, reconcile, and analyze operational data across WMS, ERP, 3PL, transportation, and other logistics data sources.
* Identify performance gaps, trends, anomalies, and root causes.
* Establish clear KPI definitions and improve data consistency across internal teams and external 3PL partners.
* Develop early-warning indicators to highlight potential capacity, inventory, cost, or service issues before they materially impact operations.
* Provide fact-based recommendations and track results after improvement actions are implemented.
Reporting, Visualization & Executive Presentations
* Develop clear, actionable dashboards and analytical reporting using Power BI, Advanced Excel, and other analytics/AI tools.
* Build executive-level presentations that explain not only what happened, but why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken.
* Convert large and complex operational datasets into clear business insights for leadership and operational teams.
* Use visualization, statistical analysis, and AI-assisted analytics to simplify complex warehouse and logistics issues.
* Provide regular performance reporting covering cost, warehouse capacity, inventory, productivity, service, and operational risks.
Process Improvement, Automation & Collaboration
* Partner with warehouse operations, transportation, finance, IT, procurement, and 3PL providers to implement data-driven operational improvements.
* Lead analytical initiatives focused on reducing logistics costs, improving inventory accuracy, reducing damage, optimizing warehouse space, and improving service performance.
* Identify opportunities for process automation, AI-enabled workflows, and system improvements.
* Support WMS, ERP, reporting, and data-system enhancements from an operational analytics perspective.
* Establish methods to measure the financial and operational impact of improvement initiatives.
* Promote a culture of data-driven and AI-enabled decision-making across warehouse and logistics operations.
* Ability to travel up to 40% of the time as required.
**Skills & Qualifications
** Warehouse Operations & Supply Chain Knowledge
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations and management, including receiving, storage, inventory control, replenishment, order fulfillment, shipping, capacity planning, and 3PL operations.
* Strong understanding of warehouse cost drivers and the relationship between inventory, space, labor, transportation, service, and operating cost.
* Ability to convert warehouse operational challenges into measurable analytics and improvement opportunities.
* Experience evaluating 3PL operational and financial performance.
AI & Advanced Analytics Skills
* Strong knowledge of AI applications within logistics, warehousing, and supply chain management.
* Experience applying AI, predictive analytics, machine learning concepts, or advanced analytical techniques to operational business problems.
* Ability to identify practical AI use cases and distinguish between opportunities that provide measurable business value and those that do not.
* Experience using generative AI and AI-enabled analytics tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, research, documentation, and decision support.
* Understanding of AI-related data quality, validation, governance, security, and human-review requirements.
* Ability to translate AI concepts into practical solutions for warehouse operators and business leaders.
Technical Skills
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, including PivotTables, Power Query, complex formulas, scenario modeling, and large-data analysis.
* Strong experience with Power BI or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
* Strong data analytics and statistical modeling capabilities.
* Experience working with WMS, ERP, 3PL, and logistics data platforms.
* Advanced forecasting, scenario modeling, KPI analysis, and root-cause analysis capabilities.
* SQL, Python, Power Automate, or comparable analytical/automation skills are highly desirable.
Professional Skills
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to combine warehouse operational knowledge, data, and AI to develop practical recommendations.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into concise executive-level insights and presentations.
* Strong attention to data accuracy, analytical integrity, and measurable business outcomes.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across operations, finance, IT, transportation, leadership, and external 3PL partners.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytics or AI concepts to nontechnical audiences.
**Experience
**
* 7+ years of experience in logistics, warehouse operations, supply chain analytics, industrial engineering, or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience in warehouse/logistics forecasting, KPI management, operational analytics, and performance reporting.
* Experience applying advanced analytics, automation, or AI-related solutions to logistics or warehouse operations.
* Experience working with 3PL providers and warehouse operations strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to turn data analysis into measurable operational or financial improvements.
Key Success Metrics
**Success In This Position Will Be Measured By
**
* Improved accuracy and actionability of logistics and warehouse forecasts.
* Reduced logistics and warehouse operating costs.
* Higher inventory accuracy and improved warehouse utilization.
* Reduced damage, operational exceptions, and avoidable costs.
* Earlier identification of warehouse capacity and operational risks.
* Improved quality and speed of management reporting and decision support.
* Measurable benefits from AI, automation, and advanced analytics initiatives.
* High-quality dashboards and executive presentations that drive management decisions.
* Successful implementation and measurement of continuous-improvement initiatives.

* [Report this job](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/ask/TS-RIC-LO?entityUrn=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fjobs%2Fview%2Felectrical-qa-qc-manager-at-gaylor-electric-inc-4452288240)
**SCOPE OF WORK
** The Quality Assurance Manager for Gaylor Electric is expected to understand and interpret design packages for projects and be capable of interpreting job site specifications. The ideal candidate can establish and maintain quality control goals through training to ensure employee awareness of the roles and responsibilities regarding quality assurance.
The Quality Assurance Manager must be independent self-motivated, innovative, resourceful, and possess strong organizational and communication skills. The Quality Assurance Manager is pivotal in electrical installations to ensure the highest standards of quality, safety, and reliability, maintaining customer satisfaction and a competitive edge in the market.
**Position Requirements
**
* Uses Gaylor Core Values as tools to carry out all job responsibilities
* Promotes the philosophy of Gaylor Core Values, inspires commitment to excellence and openness to effectively promote Gaylor’s culture
* Fosters a culture of quality throughout Gaylor by promoting awareness and accountability
* Must be self-motivated and work without direct supervision
* Must display sound judgement and decision making
* Partners with others to identify and meet Gaylor objectives and customer needs
* Works collaboratively with other departments to perform advanced, diversified, and complex tasks
* Strong administrative, organization, and communication skills
* Organizes and prioritizes workload to meet deadlines
* Displays exceptional organization skills for record keeping and documentation purposes
* Must be able to read and interpret design packages for projects and job site specifications
* Extensive knowledge of National Electrical Code and AHJ requirements
**Responsibilities
** **POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
**
* Designs, implements, and maintains quality management systems to ensure compliance with industry standards, regulations, and customer requirements
* Establishes and maintains QC procedures for each stage of the manufacturing and/or installation process and conducts regular inspections, audits, and evaluations to identify areas for improvement
* Establishes key quality performance indicators to assess and analyze effectiveness of QA processes to identify areas for improvement
* Utilizes data analytics to identify trends, root causes of issues, and opportunities for improvement
* Leads continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, reduce defects, and optimize processes
* Works closely with other departments to address quality issues, resolve conflicts, and drive continuous improvement initiatives
* Collaborates with suppliers to establish quality standards for raw materials and components
* Conducts supplier audits and assessments to ensure compliance with quality requirements
* Provides and initiates QC training on procedures, best practices and ensures awareness of roles and responsibilities regarding QA
* Maintains accurate records and ensures documentation is complete, organized, and accessible for audits
* Monitors customer feedback to identify areas for improvement and implements corrective actions
* Collaborates with other departments to address customer concerns and ensure satisfaction
* Identifies potential risks to product quality and develops strategies to mitigate risks through assessments, implementing preventive measures, and establishing contingency plans
* Leads and conducts quality control meetings with project team and/or customer
* Creates and maintains Quality and Commissioning Schedules on the jobsite
* Communicates and manages open observations with installation teams
**WORKING CONDITIONS
**
* May require working in all elements (heat, cold, rain, snow, etc.) depending on job location and/or time of year
* Must be able to utilize construction site sanitary facilities (port-o-lets)
* Must have required hand tools at all times while at work site (waist tool belts can weigh up to 30 lbs.)
* Must be able to work scheduled hours as well as overtime, as required, on short notice
* Must be able to work in noisy environments
* Must be able to remain calm in times of heightened emotional situations
* Must work well with others as a member of a team to complete tasks
**Physical Requirements
**
* Must be able to wear personnel protective equipment (i.e., hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, high visibility vest, safety harness, etc.) when required
* Ability to stand, bend, stoop, squat, crawl, climb, kneel, balance, push, pull, and reach overhead for extended periods of time
* Ability to lift loads of up to 51 lbs.
* Repetitive use of arms, hands, and fingers
* Ability to climb and use ladders and scaffolding of all types for extended periods of time
* Possess good vision/hearing (normal or corrected)
* Ability to make transition from designated employee parking areas to construction areas and be able to gain access to all levels of building/structure, even if only means of access is by OSHA approved site construction ladder or stairs still under construction but deemed safe for use
* Ability to work while constantly moving
* Ability to reach and stretch to position equipment, fixtures, etc. while maintaining balance
* Ability to use both hands simultaneously for tying knots and for proper use of power equipment
* Must be able to see color to discern color-coded wiring
* Must be physically capable of pulling wires and cables through conduits
**EDUCATION
**
* High school graduate, or equivalent
* Apprenticeship completion or relevant craft electrician certification preferred
**Experience
**
* Three or more years in electrical QC preferred
* NFPA 70E preferred; Journeymen license preferred
* Bilingual English/Spanish speaking preferred
* Seniority level
  Mid-Senior level
* Employment type
  Full-time
* Industries
  Construction
